maria (Docs): Heads-up 9 I opened a tiny PR to clarify parse fallback guidance for function-calling + JSON schema use cases: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4890. Adds: short recs, JS + Python SDK snippets, and a sample enum fallback.

ajay (Eng): on it. can we keep snippets focused on non-streaming final-parse? streaming parsing is a separate advanced section.

maria (Docs): yes, main section = final parse. add a one-line callout: "streaming: may emit partial JSON; prefer final-parse or use token-reassembly helper".

hyun (Platform): tiny nit: mention our `parseWithFallback` returns {status, result, raw} so teams can instrument failures.

leo (DevEx): I'll swap the plain JSON.parse examples to use `parseWithFallback` in JS and `parse_with_fallback` in py. snippet: ```js
const resp = await client.chat.create({model:'open-redwood-1',input: prompt});
const {status, result} = parseWithFallback(resp.output, schema, {fallbackValue: {action: 'unknown'}});
if (status !== 'ok') console.warn('parse failed, using fallback');
```

sam (ML): also recommend showing a small invalid-enum example and the expected fallback. e.g. schema with enum ["lookup","summarize"], model returns "fetch" -> fallback to "unable_to_parse" or normalized value.

maria (Docs): good idea. keep wording simple: show both schema snippet and expected parse result. avoid long theory.

pr-bot: PR #4890 created  2 files changed.

ajay (Eng): left 3 comments: 1) wording about streaming caveat, 2) link to runtime tokenization note, 3) suggest adding a one-liner about metric instrumentation for parse failures.

hyun (Platform): I'll add the metric line (count parse_failures by route/model) in a follow-up commit.

leo (DevEx): pushed updates for SDK helpers + one unit test in examples repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/commit/def456. also added a tiny doc example showing stable fallback shape.

maria (Docs): thanks. @lint-bot can you run the linter + staging deploy after CI?

lint-bot: Lint check queued.

pr-bot: CI passed  Lint passed. Staging deploy: https://staging.docs.redwood.com/build/1623

maria (Docs): staging preview looks OK. merging to main after deploy completes. planning a short follow-up to cover streaming reassembly patterns. :rocket:
